response.description: The functionality of application volume group for Oracle has been expanded with the ability to create data protection volumes in a volume group with the same anti-affinity layout as production volume groups. Customers benefit from this ability for creating disaster recovery volume layouts that support production failover to a zone or region of their choice.  This feature is available in all regions that support Azure NetApp Files.   Learn more: What's new in Azure NetApp Files Understand Azure NetApp Files application volume group for Oracle
response.title: Generally Available: Application volume group for Oracle create data protection volume group (API)
